rules.citation: Rent Board Regulation 1148; Berkeley Municipal Code section 13.76.110A.
rules.title: 2026 Annual General Adjustment for Berkeley permanent rent ceilings
rules.requirement: Eligible Berkeley landlords may increase 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% for 2026, but not before January 1, 2026. The 2026 AGA cannot be used to adjust rent for tenants whose tenancy began on or after January 1, 2025 and whose rent was set under the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act.
rules.key_value: 1.0% AGA; 65% of Bay Area CPI increase

coverage.other_unresolvable: Applies to eligible landlords and 2025 permanent rent ceilings; Regulation 1148 contains further qualification conditions not reproduced in the notice.
coverage.summary: Applies to eligible Berkeley rent-stabilized tenancies with 2025 permanent rent ceilings, subject to qualifications in Regulation 1148.

rules.exemptions: The 2026 AGA may not adjust tenants’ rents when their tenancy began on or after January 1, 2025, and their rents were set pursuant to the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act.
rules.interaction: The notice states the AGA is established under Berkeley Municipal Code section 13.76.110A and cannot apply to certain tenancies with rents set under the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act.
rules.quoted_span:
At its regular meeting on October 16, 2025, the Berkeley Rent Stabilization Board 
adopted the Annual General Adjustment (AGA) Order for Year 2026 which will allow 
eligible landlords to increase the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than 
January 1, 2026.
